title: Double shuffle and naive duality for multiple Dirichlet series
summary: Multiple zeta values admit both iterated-sum and iterated-integral representations, giving rise to the stuffle, shuffle and duality relations. Although these relations are satisfied by many families of complex numbers, we show that multiple zeta values are essentially uniquely determined by the double shuffle relations within a natural class of geometric multiple Dirichlet series. We then study geometric multiple Dirichlet series satisfying the shuffle relations and a duality relation.
